description: This PHP class 'SystemConfigurationHelper' provides methods to retrieve system configuration details such as OS info, PHP version, server software, MySQL version, and application version for the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates logic for gathering environment data and formatting it as arrays or JSON.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationHelper
classes.description: A helper class that provides environment and system configuration details for the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: getSystemDetailsAsArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing system details like OS, PHP, MySQL, server, and OrangeHRM version.

methods.name: getOsDetails
methods.description: Retrieves operating system details including name, release, and version.

methods.name: getServerDetails
methods.description: Returns server software information from the $_SERVER superglobal.

methods.name: getMySqlDetails
methods.description: Provides MySQL client and server version information.

methods.name: getOHRMDetails
methods.description: Returns the version of the OrangeHRM system from configuration.

methods.name: getSystemDetailsAsJson
methods.description: Serializes system details array into JSON format.

methods.name: getMySqlServerVersion
methods.description: Fetches the MySQL server version using Doctrine ORM and PDO attributes.
